title: The full CPU research path next to the hybrid and full-GPU peak 2, per new frame
semantics: MEASUREMENT round. No algorithm, kernel or default changes: every arm is an existing option on main 2d85d3a. candidate_dedup_top_k=3 stays semantics-changing and off by default. GUI, core and research defaults are unchanged whatever the result.
implementation_note: 8a20ed9 adds only tools/benchmark_cpu_path.py and tests/test_cpu_path_harness.py to main 2d85d3a; C++, Metal and CMake sources equal main. The frozen runner is build/stage45-release (Release, GUI+experiments+OpenCV) built from the round-45 worktree at 8a20ed9; its hash is recorded in every manifest.
question: Q1 (reported, names a winner only under the consistency rule): per new frame (every call through Session::updateSource), which of the six arms {cpu_full, hybrid_best, full_gpu_parallel} x {off, k3} is fastest on each formal case?

Q2 (reported, a direction is named only when all 6 paired blocks agree with the pooled medians): per new frame, the CPU path against the hybrid with the same dedup arm, and against full-GPU peak2+k3; k3 against off on each method.
Q3 (gated): is k3 GT-neutral on the CPU path over the round-43 hybrid GT case variants?
baseline: Same build, same frames job per case. Only frames (per new frame) are compared across methods; static calls are not run (the hybrid and CPU reuse their pose context on static calls). Speedups are never multiplied with earlier rounds; round 34's CPU/Metal refinement comparison used another build and a Metal front end for both.

methods.cpu_full: the hybrid_best job with backend 0 (CPU coarse and fine), refinement_backend 0 (CPU pose refinement), ncc_mode 0, fine_ncc_mode 0, fine_fused false, fine_angle_reuse false, overlap_enabled false (the pipeline rejects these Metal-only options on the CPU) and pose_storage_mode 0 (shared pose pages require Metal refinement); cpu_threads is the runner default 8, the M4 Pro's performance-core count; the CPU NCC calls the core dot product with Backend::Auto (NEON+DOTPROD on this build)
methods.hybrid_best: round-40 hybrid_best (Metal coarse with exact CPU normalization, Metal fine and pose refinement); jobs equal the round-44 frames jobs
methods.full_gpu_parallel: full_gpu=true, coarse_peak_mode 1, full_gpu_peak_mode 2, full_gpu_peak_batch 8, full_gpu_fine_mode 4; jobs equal the round-44 frames jobs

arms: 6 = frames x {cpu_full, hybrid_best, full_gpu_parallel} x {off, k3}

cases.formal: many128_pose, many512_pose, controlled6, 8k_t256_angle180_3scales (stage-37 fixtures, hashes checked)
cases.gt: the 112 round-43 GT case variants that have a hybrid path (round-40 13, round-34 challenge 6 and Blender 4, round-33 5, round-34 scale support 33 without and 33 with scale_support_refine, round-35 49-object RGB 16, round-43 symmetric and adjacent controls 2 regenerated by tools/candidate_dedup_scenes.py)

frame_warmup_calls.rule: the round-44 counts for every arm (the CPU arms only need fewer calls for 1 s); every worker must show >= 1 s of warm-up wall time (gate)

phases.gt: 112 case variants x cpu_full x {off, k3}: one fresh process each, first call + 1 repeat, up to 2 in parallel; GT, CPU route and job checks only, no timing claims; timeout 1800 s per worker
phases.pilot: 1 block x 6 arms x 4 cases, 2 measured calls; screening only, never decision evidence
phases.formal: 6 blocks x 6 arms x 4 cases, 3 measured calls, fresh process per case/arm/block, arm order reversed on odd blocks, cases run one after another; refuses to start with competing build/benchmark processes

accuracy.strict: many_object_accuracy.evaluate: one-to-one, position <= 2 px, wrapped angle <= 1 degree, scale ratio within 2%; FP and FN both counted
accuracy.formal_gt: every first, warm-up and measured call of every arm has zero strict FP and FN
accuracy.gt_neutral_rule: CPU k3 is GT-neutral when no GT case variant has fewer strict TP or more strict FP than CPU off (first call); known failures and controls included; a failed worker makes the phase not neutral
accuracy.cpu_versus_metal: CPU strict counts and outputs against the round-43 Metal hybrid archive are reported per case variant, not gated (CPU coarse scores are binary64, Metal FP32)

identity.round43_archive: every hybrid and full-GPU call's ordered matches and proposals equal the round-43 archived first call of the same case, path and dedup arm (gate)
identity.cross_block: every call of an arm, across all blocks, equals that arm's first call (gate, all arms including the CPU)
identity.gt_jobs: CPU GT jobs equal the round-43 hybrid GT jobs apart from the CPU option keys, the peak keys and repeats; source and template are compared by SHA-256 against round 43's input-sha256.json, not by path (round-44 lesson)

gates.routes: CPU: full_gpu disabled with 0 command buffers and 0 bytes, frame coarse/fine GPU bytes 0, pose GPU bytes 0, 0 refinement dispatches and command buffers, configured and selected refinement backend 0, pose storage 0, every per-model work row with 0 coarse and fine commands and 0 coarse GPU bytes, refinement candidates equal proposals when refining; hybrid: the round-42 route (Metal refinement, residency); full GPU: round-42 route plus peak mode 2 with 1..8 maps per dispatch
gates.dedup: counters consistent with the arm on every call and constant across calls
gates.warmup: frames warm-up wall >= 1 s in every worker
gates.rss: per method: peak RSS k3 <= off + max(8 MiB, 10%)
gates.host: no competing build/benchmark process at formal start (hard) or before any formal worker (recorded failure)

frames_ranking: per case, the six arms ordered by pooled median frame_wall_ms; the first is named fastest only when it is faster than each of the other five in every one of the 6 paired blocks and in the pooled medians

decision.report: CURRENT_BEST states the measured CPU position per case (direction only under the consistency rule) and keeps the round-44 recommendation unless the ranking names a different fastest arm
decision.cpu_k3: k3 is called usable on the CPU path only if the GT phase is GT-neutral
decision.defaults: no default changes in any outcome

memory: Process peak RSS, hybrid frame/pose GPU buffers and named full-GPU Metal buffers are reported separately and never added.
pre_registration_disclosure: Implementation smoke on the round-44 frozen runner (C++ identical), CPU frames jobs with 1 warm-up and 1 measured call (seen, not evidence): per-frame wall about 3.16 s (off) and 1.88 s (k3) at 128 objects, 10.4 s and 5.9 s at 512, 199 ms and 136 ms on controlled6, 441 ms on 8K for both; strict GT passed on all eight; no Metal buffers or dispatches. The first attempt failed with 'Shared pose storage requires Metal refinement', which fixed pose_storage_mode 0 for the CPU arm.

Tool checks on controlled6 and 8K CPU frames jobs with 3 warm-up calls validated the CPU route and dedup contracts on real output (controlled6 tripped the 1 s warm-up gate with 3 calls, as expected); CPU k3 kept 1382/2488 candidates on controlled6 and 402/531 on 8K.
cpu_threads 8, the warm-up counts, the cases, blocks and gates were fixed before any run.
limits: Single Apple M4 Pro (8 performance + 4 efficiency cores, 48 GiB); one CPU thread count (8), no thread sweep
The CPU path's exact binary64 coarse search and separate pose storage are what the pipeline supports on the CPU; it is not a hand-tuned CPU implementation
Synthetic or semi-synthetic ground truth; per-frame scope repeats the same source pixels through updateSource
Sibling sessions may use the machine; host state is recorded for every worker
